items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### Authentication, Authorization, and User Management

*   [Frontegg](https://frontegg.com) - Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and multi-tenant user management. The free plan includes 7,500 MAUs

### ⏱️ Productivity (109) / ✏️ Text (17) * [nastro (⭐29)](https://github.com/scaccogatto/nastro) - Terminal call recorder for macOS that captures system audio and mic (no bot joins the call) and transcribes on-device with speaker diarization, via TUI or headless CLI. **Languages:** Go Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/scaccogatto/nastro (⭐29)](https://github.com/scaccogatto/nastro)
Screenshots

### 🛠️ Utilities (179) / ✏️ Text (17) * [Browser Cookie Bridge (⭐9)](https://github.com/apoorvdarshan/browser-cookie-bridge) - Transfer signed-in sessions between local Chromium browsers and ChatGPT Codex on macOS. **Languages:** Swift JavaScript **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Clipbara (⭐245)](https://github.com/mobrava/Clipbara) - Paste-like clipboard manager with pinboards, Quick Look previews, search, and one-click copying. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/mobrava/Clipbara (⭐245)](https://github.com/mobrava/Clipbara)
Screenshots

* [FunNotch](https://github.com/JoshuaT1105/FunNotch) - Puts the MacBook notch to work: media controls, a drag-and-drop file shelf, clipboard history, focus sessions that block sites and apps, and twelve configurable widgets. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

Screenshots

Screenshots

Screenshots

### 🔒 Security (17) / ✏️ Text (17) * [Holeberry (⭐104)](https://github.com/pedrovieira/Holeberry) - A native and modern macOS menu bar app to monitor and control your Pi-hole instances. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**

Screenshots

items.title: Awesome Game Remakes
items.content_text:
### Arcade

*   [FsHockey](https://github.com/Thorium/FsHockey) - Retro ice hockey game in F# inspired by The Solar Hockey League (DOS); WinForms, MonoGame and browser versions. :flower\_playing\_cards:
*   [FsRocket](https://github.com/Thorium/FsRocket) - 1-4 player split-screen cave-flyer in F# modelled on AUTS (1995), with an AUTS level reader. :flower\_playing\_cards:

### FPS

*   [Can It Run Minecraft (⭐0)](https://github.com/pragyaangaur/Can-It-Run-Minecraft) - Minecraft's first version (rd-132211) rebuilt as one freestanding C file that runs in a terminal, in a browser, inside a PDF and on a bare 486 PC. :flower\_playing\_cards:

### RPG

*   [Dragon Ball Z: Super Saiya Densetsu](https://github.com/JackRushante/DBZ-Super-Saiya-Densetsu-Rust) - Rust rewrite and static recomp of the SNES card RPG, with an optional HD remaster mode.

### Platformer

*   [FsLemming](https://github.com/Thorium/FsLemming) - Lemmings clone in F# compiled to JavaScript with Fable, playable in the browser. :flower\_playing\_cards:

items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### Audio & Speech

*   [Remove Audio](https://remove-audio.com/tools/extract-voice-from-video) - Extracts clean dialogue or vocals from a video with an AI model that runs in the browser, so the file is not uploaded. `#freemium`

### Data & BI

*   [DC Hub](https://dchub.cloud/) - DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. Add <https://dchub.cloud/mcp> as an MCP server in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. `#freemium` `#mcp`

### Dating

*   [EroLove](https://erolove.ai/) - AI roleplay chat for adults, with memory across conversations, ready-made scenes, and group chats with up to four characters. `#freemium`

### Developer Tools

*   [Aident Loadout](https://aident.ai/) - Connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients to your apps and 400+ expert-built Skills through one remote MCP server, CLI or Skill, with credentials kept in a vault and every action logged. `#freemium` `#mcp`
*   [CurlShot](https://curlshot.com/) - Screenshot API that captures any URL, HTML, or Markdown as PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, or scrolling video, with a hosted MCP server so AI agents can take screenshots. Free plan with 100 screenshots/month. `#freemium` `#api` `#mcp`
*   [ShellWire](https://shellwire.com/) - Software discovery directory with explainable utility rankings, source-backed tool comparisons, and a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for AI assistants. `#free`
*   [The Enso Method (⭐5)](https://github.com/EnsoDynamics/enso-method) - Agent skills for Claude Code and Codex that record business assumptions with evidence and confidence, and preserve requirements as the source of truth. `#free` `#opensource`

### Human Resources

*   [CareJobs.Now](https://carejobs.now) - Free AI job search for US healthcare workers: describe the job you want in plain words and it matches you to 170,000+ hospital and clinic jobs with posted pay. `#free`

### Image Editing

*   [BatchSet](https://batchset.com/tools/ai-background-removal) - Remove image backgrounds with AI right in your browser, then convert, compress or resize whole folders at once. Free without signup. `#freemium`

### Image Generator

*   [Muse Studio](https://muse-me-avatar-beta.zhangwei798879.chatgpt.site/create) - Generates static ad concepts from text with editable headline, offer and CTA, and PNG export. Limited free beta; ChatGPT sign-in; no card. `#free` `#design`

### Models

*   [ArtificialWatch](https://artificialwatch.com/) - AI model release tracker that checks provider APIs every 60 seconds and alerts you by email, push, SMS or phone call when a new model goes live. `#freemium`

### SEO

*   [AltoRank](https://altorank.co/) - Open-source SEO content software that researches what your buyers search for and drafts sourced articles; self-host it free or use the hosted version. `#freemium` `#seo` `#opensource`

### Social Media

*   [OpenSparta](https://opensparta.com/) - AI-enabled Telegram workspace for audience discovery, account management, and streamlined engagement. `#freemium` `#social-media`

  • Dimble - Menu bar manager built for macOS 27's rebuilt menu bar. Hides the icons you don't need until you do.
  • Dynamic Menu Bar - Changes the color and shape of the macOS menu bar with live screen-matched colors, gradients, a music visualizer and per-app profiles.

Utilities / General Tools

  • MagicWall (⭐1) - Set local videos as desktop wallpapers.

Utilities / Window Management

  • mFix - Open-source window manager with keyboard and drag snapping, snap layouts, a Cmd+Tab window switcher with live previews, and Dock window previews.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [Kuudo Skills (⭐2)](https://github.com/KuudoAI/skills) - Gemini CLI extension with 22 Agent Skills for Amazon sellers and advertisers: Sponsored Products and Brands audits, search-term mining, budget pacing, DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud, listings, product images, repricing, FBA inbound, and profitability, built for Kuudo's hosted Amazon Ads and SP-API MCP servers. Price, budget, listing, and shipment writes are previewed and wait for your approval. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/KuudoAI/skills`. PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (source-available).
*   [Gemini Safety Net (⭐3)](https://github.com/kenryu42/gemini-safety-net) - Gemini CLI extension that runs [cc-safety-net (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/kenryu42/cc-safety-net) as a `BeforeTool` hook. It blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands, and reads of secrets such as SSH keys and `.env` files, before Gemini runs the tool call. It parses the command, so wrapped forms such as `bash -c` are also checked. It is not a sandbox. MIT. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/kenryu42/gemini-safety-net`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [SafetyCard (⭐3)](https://github.com/safetycard/safetycard) - Safety-check MCP servers and AI agents against the OWASP agentic Top 10, and get the safest setup to run them. Install with `npx skills add safetycard/safetycard --agent gemini-cli`.
